title: Ring upgraded its peephole doorbell camera to 2K
summary: Ring has upgraded its peephole doorbell camera from 1080p to 2K resolution with improved tracking and a sleeker design. The Peephole Cam 2K installs without drilling or wiring and costs $99.99, launching later this month. The upgrade demonstrates Ring's continued focus on accessible smart home security.
content:
Ring has debuted a new version of its smart doorbell camera that's designed to be easily installed as a replacement for a door's peephole without drilling or running wires. The Peephole Cam 2K is a replacement for the brand's Door View Cam that first debuted in 2019 and, alongside a sleeker design, it features a bump from 1080P to 2K video recording, some tracking upgrades, and a cheaper price. It's available for preorder now for $99.99 with shipping expected later this month.

zh.title: Ring将门铃摄像头升级至2K分辨率
zh.summary: Ring已将其门铃摄像头从1080p升级至2K分辨率，改进了跟踪功能和设计。Peephole Cam 2K无需钻孔或布线即可安装，售价99.99美元，将于本月晚些时候推出。该升级展示了Ring在易用智能家居安全领域的持续创新。

title: Traveling this summer? Don’t go without these essential gadgets
summary: The Verge curates a selection of travel gadgets across multiple price points, including wearable reading lights, belt bags, sunglasses, and item trackers to enhance summer trips. The guide offers practical solutions for both comfort and convenience during travel. Products range from affordable to premium options for different budgets.
content:
There's a chance that you've already taken your big summer trip. If not, August and early autumn are wonderful times to travel. No matter when or where you go, there are some products that can make the boring parts of your trip more fun, and the fun parts of your trip even better.
We picked a couple dozen products at a range of price points to best suit your budget. At the affordable end, we found a wearable reading light that's great for reading on a plane or in a hotel while you're adjusting to a different time zone. We also included affordable belt bags, sunglasses, item trackers, and other practical products (as well as picks that are j …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 今年夏天旅行？不能错过这些必备小工具
zh.summary: The Verge精选了不同价位的旅行小工具，包括可穿戴阅读灯、腰包、太阳镜和物品追踪器，以增强夏季旅行体验。该指南为旅行中的舒适和便利提供了实用方案。产品涵盖从经济型到高端型的各种选择，满足不同预算。

title: Disney says it’s ‘exploring’ adding a free tier to Disney Plus
summary: Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro confirmed the company is exploring a free, ad-supported tier for Disney Plus to reach price-sensitive customers and drive growth. While no specifics were announced, Disney views this as a strategic option to expand market reach. The move reflects industry trends of streaming services adding free tiers to compete.
content:
Disney is looking into launching a free streaming option. When asked about Disney's plans for free, ad-supported streaming during an earnings call on Wednesday, Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro confirmed the company is "exploring a free product for consumers."
D'Amaro added that a free tier will help drive growth and expand the streaming service's reach "to a customer segment that's more price sensitive." Though D'Amaro said that there's "nothing specific to announce today," he noted that a free tier is "definitely something that we're considering."

Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Disney表示正在"探索"为Disney Plus添加免费层级
zh.summary: Disney首席执行官Josh D'Amaro确认公司正在探索为Disney Plus添加免费、含广告的层级，以吸引价格敏感的客户并推动增长。虽然未公布具体细节，但Disney认为这是扩大市场覆盖的战略举措。这一趋势反映了流媒体服务行业添加免费层级来竞争的大势所趋。

title: Disney+ looks to TikTok creators to bring fan content to its short-form video feed
summary: Disney+ is partnering with TikTok to bring creator-generated content to its short-form video feed as streamers compete for viewer attention. The partnership aims to attract TikTok creators and their audiences to Disney's platform. The collaboration reflects Disney's efforts to integrate into the growing creator economy.
content: As streamers compete with social media giants for viewer attention, Disney+ is partnering with TikTok to bring creator content to its app.

zh.title: Disney+ 寻求与TikTok创作者合作为其短视频平台引入粉丝内容
zh.summary: Disney+ 正与 TikTok 合作，为其短视频平台带来创作者生成的内容，以应对流媒体竞争。该合作旨在吸引 TikTok 创作者及其观众来到迪士尼平台。这一协作反映了迪士尼融入不断增长的创作者经济的努力。

title: MacPaw taps Liquid AI to offer on-device inference to devs building for its app store
summary: MacPaw is partnering with Liquid AI to build a local version of its AI assistant Eney using Liquid AI's models for on-device inference. Developers building for MacPaw's app store gain access to AI capabilities without relying on cloud services. The integration emphasizes privacy and performance benefits.
content: MacPaw is building a local version of its AI assistant Eney using Liquid AI's models.

zh.title: MacPaw 与 Liquid AI 合作为其应用商店开发者提供本地推理功能
zh.summary: MacPaw 与 Liquid AI 合作，使用 Liquid AI 的模型为其 AI 助手 Eney 构建本地版本，实现本地推理。为 MacPaw 应用商店构建应用的开发者可以获得 AI 功能，而无需依赖云服务。该集成强调了隐私和性能优势。

title: Robinhood to list a fund that lets anyone back Y Combinator startups
summary: Robinhood is launching a new financial instrument enabling retail investors to invest in Y Combinator startups, democratizing access to early-stage venture capital. This product allows individual investors to potentially benefit from backing promising startups. The offering targets retail investors interested in venture opportunities.
content: Robinhood's latest financial instrument intends to let any retail investor feel like they, too, can make money by backing Y Combinator startups.

zh.title: Robinhood 推出基金让任何人都能支持 Y Combinator 初创企业
zh.summary: Robinhood 推出新的金融工具，让零售投资者能够投资 Y Combinator 初创企业，民主化获取早期风险投资的途径。该产品允许个人投资者从支持有前景的初创企业中获益。该产品针对有兴趣参与风险投资的零售投资者。

title: Disney gives TikTok creators official access to Marvel, Star Wars, and Pixar characters
summary: Disney partnered with TikTok to give creators official access to Marvel, Star Wars, and Pixar assets for short-form video creation on Disney Plus's Verts feed. The pilot program launches in the US before expanding internationally, offering opt-in creators Disney-branded content opportunities. The partnership integrates creator content into Disney's streaming strategy.
content:
Disney is introducing fan-created TikTok content to its Disney Plus app in its latest attempt to break into short-form creator videos. The Walt Disney Company announced today that it's partnering with TikTok to bring "an expansive collection of thoughtfully curated Disney-centric fan-created content" to the Verts video feed it launched on Disney Plus earlier this year, providing creators with access to assets from "hundreds" of movies and TV shows.
The partnership will be piloted in the US "in the coming months," according to Disney, with plans to launch in other markets later. Videos from TikTok creators who opt-in to the program will be h …

zh.title: Disney为TikTok创作者提供对漫威、星球大战和皮克斯角色的官方访问权限
zh.summary: Disney与TikTok合作，为创作者提供了对漫威、星球大战和皮克斯资产的官方访问权限，用于在Disney Plus Verts频道上进行短视频创建。该试点项目在美国推出，然后向国际扩展，为选择加入的创作者提供迪士尼品牌内容机会。该合作将创作者内容整合到迪士尼的流媒体策略中。

title: Indian EV startup River raises $120M Series C to scale production, launch more models
summary: Indian EV startup River raised $120 million in Series C funding to expand manufacturing and launch additional models starting in 2027. The capital supports production scaling and a path toward profitability in India's competitive EV market. River aims to strengthen its position among emerging automotive manufacturers.
content: River plans to build a new factory, launch additional models from 2027, and target profitability as it scales production.

zh.title: 印度电动汽车初创公司River融资1.2亿美元C轮以扩大生产、推出更多车型
zh.summary: 印度电动汽车初创公司River筹集了1.2亿美元的C轮融资，以扩大生产和从2027年开始推出更多车型。该资金支持生产扩展和在印度竞争激烈的电动汽车市场中实现盈利的道路。River旨在加强其在新兴汽车制造商中的地位。

title: Google Assistant will disappear from your phone next month
summary: Google will remove Google Assistant from Android phones, tablets, and paired devices starting September 4th, transitioning users to Gemini. The deprecation marks the end of Assistant's era following Gemini's introduction as Google's newer AI system. The migration completes Google's shift away from the older assistant technology.
content:
Farewell, Google Assistant art, we hardly knew ye. | Illustration by Alex Castro / The Verge	

Google Assistant's days have been numbered ever since Gemini arrived on the scene, and its time is now up. Google has announced that it will be removing access to Assistant on Android phones and tablets, along with paired devices like smartwatches or headphones, from September 4th.
The announcement came in an email apparently sent to some users, as reported by 9to5Google and shared in full on Reddit. The Verge has asked Google for confirmation that the email is accurate, and will update this story once we have it.

zh.title: Google助手将在下个月从你的手机上消失
zh.summary: 谷歌将从9月4日开始从安卓手机、平板电脑和配对设备中移除Google助手，将用户转换到Gemini。该弃用标志着在Gemini推出作为谷歌较新的AI系统后，助手时代的结束。迁移完成了谷歌远离旧助手技术的转变。

title: Pushing the limits: Infinite Machine's Olto is barely a bicycle
summary: Infinite Machine's Olto uses a scooter-like layout that makes pedaling suboptimal while still incorporating pedals for propulsion. The design pushes conventional boundaries of what constitutes a bicycle. The vehicle represents an experimental approach to personal transportation.
content: Scooter layout makes pedaling a bad experience. But it does have pedals.

zh.title: 推动极限：Infinite Machine的Olto勉强算是自行车
zh.summary: Infinite Machine的Olto采用踏板车式布局，使踏板效率不佳，但仍然整合了踏板用于动力推进。该设计突破了自行车的传统界限。该车辆代表了个人交通的一种实验性方法。

title: Saudi Aramco backs India’s Mitti Labs to make Asia’s rice farming more water-resilient
summary: Saudi Aramco is backing Mitti Labs to improve water efficiency in rice farming across Asia, addressing critical agricultural and environmental challenges. Mitti Labs plans to expand from India into the Philippines and Indonesia while growing its carbon credits and agricultural data business. The investment reflects interest from oil majors in sustainable agriculture.
content: Mitti Labs plans to expand beyond India and enter the Philippines and Indonesia while growing its carbon credits and agricultural data business.

zh.title: 沙特阿美支持印度Mitti Labs，提高亚洲水稻种植的水资源韧性

title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
summary: WindBorne Systems raised $37 million in Series B funding to scale its weather balloon network and AI-powered forecasting technology. The company leverages AI advances in meteorology to build a commercially viable business model. The funding supports WindBorne's mission to improve weather prediction while demonstrating profitability.
content: WindBorne Systems has raised $37 million Series B round to scale its weather balloons and AI forecasts.

zh.title: 人工智能使天气预报更准确，WindBorne能否将其商业化？
zh.summary: WindBorne Systems在B轮融资中筹得3700万美元，用于扩展其气象气球网络和AI驱动的预报技术。该公司利用气象学中的AI进步建立商业可行的商业模式。融资支持WindBorne改进天气预报并实现盈利的使命。

title: Trump’s AI testing plan is limited and vague
summary: The Trump administration's AI cybersecurity testing framework explicitly excludes open-source models, limiting assessment to proprietary systems and raising questions about effectiveness. The voluntary guidelines state they cannot restrict open models after release, narrowing the framework's scope. The initiative stems from a June executive order requesting companies share frontier AI models with the government.
content:
The Trump administration's framework for assessing potential cybersecurity risks posed by advanced AI reportedly has no interest in testing open models. Axios reports that not only do the voluntary guidelines outright exclude open models - meaning anyone can download them and inspect their core components - but the framework explicitly says it can't be used to restrict open models after they've been released.
The AI testing framework was created after President Trump signed an executive order in June, requesting that AI companies share their frontier models with the federal government prior to release to address cybersecurity concerns. AI c …

zh.title: 特朗普的人工智能测试计划范围受限且措辞模糊
zh.summary: 特朗普政府的人工智能网络安全测试框架明确排除了开源模型，将评估范围限制在专有系统，引发了人们对其有效性的质疑。自愿指南规定他们无法在开源模型发布后对其加以限制，进一步缩小了该框架的范围。该倡议源自6月的一项行政命令，该命令要求公司与政府共享前沿人工智能模型。

title: Wispr Flow launches a Granola-styled meeting notetaker
summary: Wispr Flow is launching a meeting notetaker that generates summaries and action items, moving into productivity software similar to tools like Granola. The new feature signals the company's expansion beyond its core offering. This follows industry trends of AI-powered meeting productivity tools gaining market traction.
content: Wispr Flow's new terms of service indicate it will introduce a notetaker that generates meeting summaries and action items.

zh.title: Wispr Flow推出Granola风格的会议记录工具
zh.summary: Wispr Flow推出了一款会议记录工具,能生成摘要和行动项,进入了类似Granola的生产力软件领域。这一新功能标志着该公司业务范围的扩展。这是业界AI驱动的会议生产力工具获得市场关注的趋势的一部分。

title: Ted Lasso returns at an important time for Apple TV
summary: Apple TV is launching a fourth season of Ted Lasso as a soft reboot, mixing familiar characters with a substantially new cast. The return comes as Apple TV aggressively expands its content slate with new hits and returning favorites. The timing is significant as Apple TV pursues a larger share of the competitive streaming market.
content:
2026 is shaping up to be an excellent year for Apple TV. Apple's streaming service has built out an impressive slate that spans returning favorites like Silo and Sugar to all-new hits including OnlyFans-inspired dramedies, terrifying comedies, and paranoid tech thrillers. But the most important release might be a feel-good sports sitcom. After what seemed like a definitive finale, Ted Lasso is back with a fourth season that doubles as a soft reboot for the show, mixing up familiar characters with a substantially new cast. zh.title: 《Ted Lasso》在Apple TV的关键时期回归
zh.summary: Apple TV推出《Ted Lasso》第四季作为软重启,融合了熟悉的角色和全新阵容。该剧的回归正值Apple TV积极扩展内容库,推出新热门剧集和经典剧集回归之际。由于Apple TV争取在竞争激烈的流媒体市场占据更大份额,这个时机尤为重要。

title: SpaceX is coming for T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon
summary: SpaceX announced plans to build a terrestrial mobile network using spectrum purchased from EchoStar, directly competing with T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon. CEO Elon Musk and President Gwynne Shotwell revealed the strategy during SpaceX's first earnings call. The move signals SpaceX's intention to disrupt the wireless industry beyond its satellite internet business.
content:
SpaceX is preparing to build a terrestrial mobile network to "acquire quite a few" of the customers now subscribed to T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon. The message to compete head-to-head with the US carriers was delivered by SpaceX president Gwynne Shotwell and CEO Elon Musk during the Q&A section of the company's first earnings call.
"The spectrum that we purchased from EchoStar does have terrestrial components, so we definitely intend to build out the terrestrial component," said Shotwell. "You will have not only the capacity from the satellites themselves, but you will have a buildout of the terrestrial, basically the hardware and systems ne …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: SpaceX将与T-Mobile、AT&T和Verizon竞争
zh.summary: SpaceX宣布计划使用从EchoStar购买的频谱建立陆基移动网络,直接与T-Mobile、AT&T和Verizon竞争。首席执行官埃隆·马斯克和总裁格温妮·肖韦尔在SpaceX首次财报电话会议上透露了这一战略。此举标志着SpaceX意图在卫星互联网业务之外进一步扰动无线行业。
